title: Pulseboard onboarding visuals — latency, token-cost, and trace vignettes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, brand-forward asset pack (Pulseboard) for the onboarding quickstart that highlights runtime health: a latency distribution vignette, per-token cost sparklines, and an actionable request trace view. Assets must include annotated hero images, 3 micro-tutorial overlays, and mobile/tablet cutdowns for the docs site and in-product coach marks.
deliverables: Latency distribution vignette (annotated) — source Figma and exported JPG/PNG
Token-cost sparkline pack — animated GIF + static PNG for docs
Request trace vignette — collapsed and expanded states (with callouts explaining KV-cache hits, batching, and fallbacks)
3 micro-tutorial overlay PNGs for the quickstart carousel
Mobile/tablet cutdowns (iOS and Android safe area) and 2x retina exports
Image manifest (CSV) listing filenames, dimensions, alt text suggestions, and target doc locations
acceptance_criteria: All hero and vignette assets exported in light and dark themes with correct color tokens
Images use approved type scale and redwood brand colors; accessible contrast verified
Annotated trace view includes callouts for: request latency, cost-per-token, KV cache hit indicator, and fallback model routing
Files uploaded to Drive with folders: /Design/Pulseboard/Exports and Figma link present in ticket
Marketing and Docs approve final PNGs and GIFs (sign-offs recorded in comments)
